Calculated for retinal arterial vessel segments as path length divided by the straight-line distance between endpoints. Fundus luminance describes the overall brightness of the retinal image. Higher values indicate a brighter image. Calculated by converting the fundus image to luminance. Reported as the mean across the visible retinal area. Computed on the full image.
